messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact minute‑by‑minute time right now.  
On May 29 2026, New York City is on Eastern Daylight Time (EDT), which is **UTC‑4**.  
If you know the current UTC time, just subtract four hours to get the local time in NYC.  

For the most accurate result, check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a smart‑assistant device.
message.reasoning: User asks: "What is the current time in New York City?" We need to provide current time. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate using UTC offset. But we need to be accurate. We could use a function to get current time? There's no function for time. We can approximate by using knowledge: New York City is in Eastern Time Zone (UTC-5 standard, UTC-4 daylight saving). Today is 2026-05-29. Daylight Saving Time is in effect (DST starts second Sunday in March, ends first Sunday in November). So offset is UTC-4. Current UTC time? We don't know. We can approximate by using system time? We can't. We can say "I don't have real-time data" and suggest checking a reliable source. But maybe we can approximate by using the current time from the system? We don't have that. So best answer: "I don't have real-time data, but you can check your device or online." Provide explanation.
